text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp now over, we're all
waiting for
the bus, when...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Why does it have to end?! Why can't it
always be
summer camp?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! There's still so much crazy
training I wanna
do! Please don't let
summer end!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: The Swan Stakes won't come around ...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See ya later, summer! Swan Stakes, here
I come!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: Let's come back next year, okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Swan Stakes approaching, we
can't let
our guard down. We'll have to
bring this summer
heat into the fall!
